Argentina closed out the night with a 3-0 win over Benin, with Messi scoring in the 70th minute to bring his international career total to 208 appearances and 126 goals. A fireworks display and drone show followed the game, featuring images of Messi wearing his No. 10 jersey and lifting the World Cup trophy. Messi described the occasion as the “saddest day” of his career. | CBS News

item.title: In 2014, a Tennessee couple paid 58 cents for Vince Lombardi’s sweater; it later sold for $43,020
item.description: In an incredible find, a couple bought a sweater for just 58 cents at a Goodwill store in North Carolina back in 2014. While viewing a documentary, they learned that it had ties to famed football coach Vince Lombardi, as a tag revealed its association with his tenure at West Point. item.title: Mexico makes push for fracking despite environmental concerns
item.description: Following months of consultations with energy experts, Mexico is preparing to tap its shale oil and gas reserves using one of the world's most controversial extraction techniques: fracking. The process is already used to extract oil in the southeastern state of Veracruz, where local communities have long complained of pollution and environmental damage. But the administration of President Claudia Sheinbaum is seeking to reduce Mexico's reliance on the United States and – eventually – achieve energy self-sufficiency. FRANCE 24's Quentin Duval and Laurence Cuvillier report. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: The country’s 85-medal haul included athletes who trained with limited money and borrowed equipment. In this edition of the games, in Japan, India won 85 medals : 21 golds, 27 silver and 37 bronze medals.
